item.title: Patrick Clancy's wife to appear on 60 Minutes
item.description: Ross Douthat's interview with Patrick Clancy and Dr. Rachel Danis airs Sunday on 60 Minutes.

item.title: Patrick Clancy says he still talks to his kids "all the time"
item.description: This Sunday on 60 Minutes, Patrick Clancy talks about his grief, his memories of his children, and the baseless conspiracy theories that flooded social media since his ex-wife's murder trial.

item.title: Patrick Clancy says he still speaks to his children to "stay connected to them"
item.description: Patrick Clancy and his new wife, fertility doctor Rachel Danis, sat down with 60 Minutes this week. Shanelle Kaul has a preview of the story, which airs Sunday.

item.title: Safe and ethical AI advocate calls international cooperation "absolutely essential"
item.description: OpenAI on Thursday revealed an additional six incidents in which its artificial intelligence models exhibited unexpected or concerning behavior. Stuart Russell, a distinguished professor of computer science at UC Berkeley and president of the International Association for Safe and Ethical AI, joins CBS News to discuss.

item.title: 1 in 3 Americans with health insurance have medical debt, survey finds
item.description: Nearly half of Americans with medical debt owe at least $2,000, forcing them to make tough choices, new research shows.

item.title: Rep. Rick Larsen says lawmakers "need to get serious" about AI
item.description: From terror groups to possible existential threats to rogue bots, safety concerns over artificial intelligence have grown in recent weeks. Democratic Rep. Rick Larsen of Washington joins CBS News to discuss how Congress can act.

item.title: Week 2 of NFL season kicks off with home opener for Buffalo Bills in new stadium
item.description: The Buffalo Bills kick off Week 2 of the NFL season with a home opener in their new stadium Thursday night. CBS Sports NFL analyst Mike Renner has more.

item.title: What JD Vance's time at Yale says about his transformation from Trump critic to Trump VP
item.description: Chris Whipple, contributing writer at Vanity Fair, joins "The Daily Report" to walk through his reporting on how JD Vance's time at Yale Law may have contributed to his evolution from being an outspoken critic of President Trump to being his vice president.

item.title: FBI expanding AI usage as OpenAI discloses 6 new AI safety incidents
item.description: FBI Director Kash Patel said this week the bureau is expanding its AI usage. That statement came just as OpenAI disclosed 6 new instances of "unexpected or concerning" AI behavior. Ian Krietzberg, AI correspondent at Puck News, joins "The Daily Report."

item.title: Trump photo shows him viewing "Kennedy Center demolished" document
item.description: In court documents filed Wednesday by Rep. Joyce Beatty, a witness said he saw a "forklift run into and hit the pillars" of the building.

item.title: F-16 from Texas crashes in Michigan, evacuation order issued
item.description: Blair Township Supervisor Nicole Blonshine said she was told the aircraft was an F-16 but does not have "100% confirmation." The pilot parachuted out before it crashed, she said.

item.title: Hispanic voters who voted for Trump feel "betrayed," GOP representative says
item.description: Republican Rep. María Elvira Salazar says Hispanic Trump voters are feeling "betrayed" by his immigration crackdown. CBS News' political director Fin Gómez breaks down what this means for midterms.

item.title: 1 in 3 Americans with health insurance have medical debt, survey finds
item.description: Many Americans with health insurance are still struggling with medical debt, with some owing thousands. CBS News' Megan Cerullo reports.

item.title: Government truck inspections decline plummeting in many states
item.description: Government roadside inspections of commercial trucks are declining. With that in mind, a CBS News investigation found more than 2,000 people have been killed since 2019 in accidents involving licensed trucking companies that had no roadside inspection on record before the crash. CBS News senior investigative data journalist Steve Reilly reports.

item.title: Doctors successfully separate twin girls conjoined at the head
item.description: Two-year-old conjoined twin sisters saw each other face-to-face for the first time after a successful 24-hour surgery to separate them. Ian Lee reports from the children's hospital in St. Louis, where it happened.

item.title: Experts discuss the potential dangers of AI
item.description: Amid growing concerns about the safety of artificial intelligence following resignations and reports of models going rogue, experts joined CBS News to unpack the potential threat AI could pose to humanity.

item.title: Trump ordered DOJ not to appeal ruling loosening gun limits, sources say
item.description: President Trump ordered the Justice Department not to appeal a court ruling that loosened restrictions on firearms known as "gangster weapons," sources familiar with the matter told CBS News.

item.title: Little kid tries to run away, but is faced with the reality of the great, big world
item.description: A childhood rite of passage was caught on camera when a little kid planned to run away from home. Tony Dokoupil has the story.

item.title: Alabama executes killer of famous Elvis impersonator by lethal injection
item.description: Alabama executed a man with a chemical injection Thursday, months after a judge blocked the state from putting him to death with nitrogen gas.

item.title: Michigan synagogue reopens 6 months after terrorist attack
item.description: Six months after a terrorist rammed a truck full of explosives into a Michigan synagogue, images were released of the building restored and reopened. Jonah Kaplan has more.

item.title: Princess Diana's brother says, "I felt it my duty to lay out the true history"
item.description: The late Princess Diana's brother issued new accusations against Britain's royal family on CBS Sunday Morning in an interview that will air this weekend. Holly Williams has a preview.

item.title: Video shows flames shooting from plane engine minutes after takeoff
item.description: Passengers settling in for a flight to Mexico this week saw flames shooting from one of the plane's engines just minutes after takeoff. Kris Van Cleave has new video.

item.title: Photo shows Trump viewing pile of rubble under words, "Kennedy Center demolished"
item.description: With fencing blocking the Kennedy Center doors on Thursday, its executive director, a President Trump appointee, said the center is closed due to a "risk to public safety." Ed O'Keefe has the new details.

item.title: Trump again threatens Kennedy Center demolition
item.description: President Trump is again threatening to shut down or demolish the Kennedy Center for the Performing Arts in Washington, D.C. CBS News' Kathryn Watson has more.

item.title: GOP congresswoman says Trump immigration enforcement has "gone too far"
item.description: "The same Hispanics who helped you get to the White House in 2024 feel betrayed," said Rep. Maria Elvira Salazar.

item.title: Pilot ejects before F-16 fighter jet crashed in Michigan
item.description: An F-16 fighter jet crashed in northern Michigan on Thursday, narrowly missing homes as it slammed into the ground a few miles south of Traverse City. Jason Allen reports.

item.title: U.N. experts say U.S. may have committed war crimes with 2 Iran strikes
item.description: U.N.-commissioned rights experts say there are "reasonable grounds" to believe the U.S. committed war crimes with strikes that killed scores of Iranian civilians.

item.title: Iran recently downed at least 2 American drones, officials say
item.description: U.S. officials tell CBS News that Iran downed at least two American drones in recent days. CBS News' James Laporta reports.

item.title: 9/17: The Takeout with Major Garrett
item.description: OpenAI reports six new incidents of "concerning" behavior; U.N. panel says it has "reasonable grounds" to believe U.S. committed war crimes in Iran.

item.title: Princess Diana's brother claims Charles told him, "we'll forget her soon"
item.description: The late Prince Diana's brother claims in a new book that King Charles had "contempt" for his ex-wife, telling him she would be forgotten "soon enough."
